tool.title: Sync a swarm work item's cold-start handover runbook
tool.description: Idempotently create, claim, or refresh any parent Swarm Work Item (`epic` or `milestone`, parameterized by `--epic-id` or `--swarm-slug`, for example a repository `stability` merge swarm, a proof-closure swarm, a graph-detangling swarm, or a literature-audit swarm) with a live Cold-Start Handover Runbook synthesized from `git worktree list`, forge pull-request queues, host process/memory/swap headroom, and `beans` child queues, then push the updated handover note and state to the shared `beans` branch (`cat/cat-harness/beans`).

inputs.name: epic-id
inputs.description: Existing parent Swarm Work Item identifier in `beans`; when omitted, resolved or idempotently created from `--swarm-slug`.

inputs.name: swarm-slug
inputs.description: Goal-specific slug identifying the swarm when `--epic-id` is omitted (for example `stability`, `proof-closure`, `kg-detangle`, or `literature-audit`).

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: Forge `<owner>/<repo>` queried over REST for open and recently merged pull requests; defaults to the checkout's `origin` remote.

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: Default branch ref fetched and recorded in the handover header; default `main`.

inputs.name: state-branch
inputs.description: Shared work-plan state branch receiving the pushed handover update; default `cat/cat-harness/beans`.

inputs.name: push
inputs.description: Push the updated work-item handover snapshot to `--state-branch` immediately after writing.

inputs.name: dry-run
inputs.description: Render the Cold-Start Handover Runbook Markdown to stdout without mutating `beans` or pushing.

inputs.name: notes
inputs.description: Optional standing owner directives, acceptance criteria (`EC-1..EC-k`), safety fences, and takeover notes supplied on stdin.

outputs.name: epic
outputs.description: The parent Swarm Work Item created or refreshed.

outputs.name: snapshot
outputs.description: The synthesized Cold-Start Handover Runbook Markdown (exit criteria, child queues, live worktree/branch/HEAD/PID table, PR wave queues, standing fences, and under-60-second takeover commands).

render.reason: the cold-start handover runbook is structured Markdown tables and fenced takeover commands rendered on the parent work item

selection.when: On every routine Swarm Monitor or Merge Steward check-in tick, at swarm startup or cold takeover, and at milestone transitions when keeping a parent Swarm Work Item's Cold-Start Handover Runbook current in the shared `beans` store.
selection.limits: Requires Python 3 standard library plus local `git` (and `beans` or `beans-manual` for store writes, `gh` REST for forge PR wave tables). When offline, omit `--push` to refresh the local snapshot first.
selection.cost: Under 2 seconds locally: one `git worktree list`, one `ps`/`top` sample, one `beans list --json`, and one optional forge REST `/pulls` read plus state-branch push.

remedies.none: Run without `--push` (or with `--dry-run`) to synthesize and write the local worktree, process, and `beans` handover snapshot offline, then push to `--state-branch` once forge reachability returns.
